caption: BFI Waste Systems of New Jersey, Inc. v. Township of Monroe
citation_line: BFI Waste Systems of New Jersey, Inc. v. Township of Monroe, No. 3:23-cv-00059, ECF No. 45 (D.N.J. Jan. 24, 2025)
headnote_district_ruling: Allowed the deposition of a township mayor in landfill-remediation litigation. The opinion questioned whether a mayor of a smaller municipality is high-ranking for Morgan purposes and independently found the Buono exceptional-circumstances factors satisfied by first-hand involvement.
qualification_rationale: Addresses an unsettled threshold in the high-ranking-official doctrine and forms part of a useful D.N.J. trio with Stevenson and Rodwell.
appellate_posture_note: Non-dispositive discovery order; no substantive appellate review identified.
subject_screen_exclusion_reason: Non-dispositive ruling permitting a mayoral deposition.
